description: This file is a shell script used to fix prebuilt ELF check errors by updating 'shared_libs' fields in Android.bp files. It includes functions for usage instructions, file cleanup, property extraction/modification, and ELF dependency analysis, as well as command-line argument parsing and file manipulation logic.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: trim_space
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: get_prop
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the property dictionary.

methods.name: rewrite_prop
methods.description: Updates a property in the Android.bp file, optionally replacing or appending.

methods.name: get_dt_needed
methods.description: Examines ELF dynamic section to extract needed shared libraries.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unique items from input.
